remarks: A rare opportunity to own 6.68 acres of buildable land with endless possibilities! Zoned for single-family or two-family residential use, this property is perfect for those looking to build a custom home with plenty of space, privacy, and room to enjoy the outdoors. The parcel can also be partitioned into smaller acreage, offering flexibility for the next owner. No state wetlands! Water, gas, and electric are available, with septic and propane needed for the property. Bring your plans and create the home you’ve been envisioning, or explore the potential of dividing the land into smaller parcels. A unique opportunity to build, invest, and create something of your own!
